scope: 80 evaluated benchmark slots, assessments, source receipts, usage-only native evidence, separate excluded-attempt spend, and rendered graphs. Private full exports are not published.
limits: Actionability is selected-finding recall, not overall correctness or a readiness pass. Every assessed validation family is partial or missing under the same complete scenario/control rubric, not zero testing.
Reported first-handback tokens are optional native footer values, sometimes from status responses. They are neither workflow totals nor billed usage, and nested values must not be summed.

Reviewed visible traces, report-specific assessments, recovered native audits/reports and available earlier research logs are committed under tests/results/20261012. Full exports/native thinking/account metadata are private and not published. Privacy transformations retain hashes and reasons in evidence-index.json.

Verified final-layer reconciliation covers ten export hashes/timings and 356 exact quote memberships/counts; raw-layer reconciliation covers 175 further quote memberships/counts. Nested experiment logs remain uncollected and claims remain attributed.

Native usage covers recorded main/subagent requests within scored boundaries, not unlogged helper calls or billing adjustments. Earlier wider audit windows are documented separately; no remote source bytes were reproduced in the coordinator.

The transferred recovery collector was the immutable ff904c78 SHA256 version recorded in verification.json. The maintained collector now also retains issue-only subagent scopes; recovery files were not rerun or silently replaced.
